candidate.title: EmbeddableHost persists arbitrary categoryid without verifying category exists or is accessible
reports: [medium/data] categoryid is persisted without verifying that the category exists, allowing dangling relationships that can pass an invalid category into topic creation
app/controllers/admin/embeddablehostscontroller.rb:24 — arbitrary or concurrently deleted category ids are persisted without existence validation and are later assigned to newly imported topics.

app/models/embeddablehost.rb:3 — categoryid has no fk and no validation; deleting the category leaves a dangling id that topicembed.import then passes to postcreator, so imports for that host break or land in the wrong place with no admin-visible error.

app/models/embeddablehost.rb:3 — belongsto :category has no matching hasmany :embeddablehosts, dependent: on category and no fk, so deleting a category leaves hosts pointing at a missing categoryid and the admin ui's category-badge host.category renders nothing (p2, conf 75)
